protocol.dimension_parameter_semantics: feature_pool includes the 82 baseline features (776 additional); input_dim is the selected classifier input dimension; parameters counts classifier/network weights and biases only, excluding scaler statistics and feature selection indices. Logistic82: 82 input features, 82 coefficients plus one intercept = 83 parameters.
protocol.deep_training: inner-training only; no outer refit; max40 epochs, batch128, patience6, AdamW lr=.001 weight_decay=.01, dropout=.2
protocol.selection: variance >1e-20; optional greedy |r|<.98; ANOVA SelectKBest-equivalent stable score ranking; scaler fit only training partition
protocol.features: 82 baseline + multiresolution STFT .5/1/2s (floor half overlap) + db4/sym5/coif2 level5 zero-extension DWT + Hilbert band envelope/frequency + nonlinear
protocol.entropy: sample entropy m2 r.2 on standardized fivefold-decimated signal, pseudocount1; permutation order3 stable ties
protocol.endpoint: Hilbert and STFT use whole current six-second window only; not sample-by-sample causal within window
protocol.polarization: not applicable to single-channel EEG; no polarization features invented
protocol.limitations: exploratory repeated CV, no independent test; subject/session confounded; fixed seeds not seed robustness study
